doc.brief: Passed to various keybinding signals for deleting text.
doc.md: Passed to various keybinding signals for deleting text.

display_line_ends.brief: Delete only the portion of the display-line to the left/right of cursor.
display_line_ends.md:
Delete only the portion of the
  display-line to the left/right of cursor.

display_lines.md:
Delete display-lines. Display-lines
  refers to the visible lines, with respect to the current line
  breaks. As opposed to paragraphs, which are defined by line
  breaks in the input.

paragraph_ends.brief: Delete to the end of the paragraph.
paragraph_ends.md:
Delete to the end of the
  paragraph. Like C-k in Emacs (or its reverse).

paragraphs.brief: Delete entire line. Like C-k in pico.
paragraphs.md: Delete entire line. Like C-k in pico.

whitespace.md: Delete only whitespace. Like M-\ in Emacs.

word_ends.brief: Delete only the portion of the word to the left/right of cursor if we’re in the middle of a word.
word_ends.md:
Delete only the portion of the word to the
  left/right of cursor if we’re in the middle of a word.
